title: Entity
description: A person, persona, location, organization or object. 'first_reveal' is the earliest reveal ordinal at which the entity may be shown at all.

reveal_char_end.description: Right-endpoint character offset within the first_reveal window at or after which the entity becomes visible.

canonical_name_id.description: Name used for display; must itself be revealed at or before the view ordinal.

notes.description: Extraction-side remark. Never shown to readers.
